subject: Google Chrome could not connect to localhost:8100

messages.author: cac9bcd2d0854c9b
messages.subject: Google Chrome could not connect to localhost:8100
parts:
I am relatively new to R but wanted to try out Shiny.  I have signed up for an R Study Shiny hosting account and everything seems to be working when I log into the account and access RStudio through Chrome.  However, when I run "runExample("01_hello")" the console displays "Listening on port 8100" and a Chrome gives me the following error. "Ooops! Google Chrome could not connect to localhost:8100".

What should I do to fix this?  

My computer is running windows 8 and I am logged into an account that is an administrator.

Thanks in advance for your help with this,

Nick

messages.author: c6ca7877bef91eef
messages.subject: Re: Google Chrome could not connect to localhost:8100
parts:
Are you trying to run runExample from the web based RStudio server? In that case, it won't work. runExample is meant for use with the Desktop version of RStudio.

Ramnath
